entity.summary: Centralized cryptocurrency exchange launched in 2018 and formerly operated at extstock.com. Current exchange-directory sources classify ExtStock as inactive or untracked and preserve reports of impeded withdrawals, while the domain still exposes legacy exchange API documentation. HEI does not infer a precise shutdown date or terminal cause from those observations.
entity.notes: An operator-controlled Bitcointalk announcement from 2018 identifies ExtStock and extstock.com. CoinMarketCap describes ExtStock as a UK-based centralized exchange launched in February 2018 and currently leaves its volume untracked while noting reports of impeded withdrawals. Cryptowisser currently flags ExtStock inactive and records multiple withdrawal-failure reports from May 2020. The present extstock.com site still exposes legacy exchange API documentation, but that documentation alone does not establish current operational exchange activity. HEI therefore records inactive status without assigning scam_rug, insolvency, or an exact shutdown date.

evidence.title: [ANN] ExtStock Exchange Official Thread
evidence.notes: The thread was opened by the ExtStock account as the exchange's official Bitcointalk thread and identifies extstock.com as the website. The post date is not treated as an exact exchange launch date.

evidence.title: ExtStock trade volume and market listings
evidence.notes: CoinMarketCap describes ExtStock as a centralized exchange launched in February 2018 at a UK address. It currently leaves volume untracked and notes reports of impeded withdrawals. Month-level launch information is retained in notes rather than converted into a fabricated exact date.

evidence.title: ExtStock exchange review and inactive status
evidence.notes: Cryptowisser currently flags ExtStock inactive and records that multiple users reported failed withdrawals in May 2020. HEI uses this only to support inactive status and does not infer scam_rug or a precise terminal date.

evidence.title: ExtStock API Documentation V2
evidence.notes: The extstock.com domain currently exposes exchange-branded API documentation, including public and private trading endpoints. Because the root site could not be independently verified as a functioning exchange during review, HEI records the URL as live_unverified rather than treating the documentation as proof of active status.
